Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows a curvilinear opacity on the right side parallel to the right heart border, characteristic of the scimitar vein in Scimitar syndrome. This condition is typically associated with right lung hypoplasia, which causes deviation of the mediastinum and heart to the right, and often involves an anomalous systemic arterial supply from the inferior aorta (as seen in the coronal CT, Figure 1).
